title: PDF Filler Template Config
description: Schema for template configurations used by the generic PDF form-filling library (Trac #4042). Each JSON file in pdf_filler_templates/ conforming to this schema registers one fillable PDF template.

template_name.description: Machine-readable identifier (e.g. 'ga-poa-dca'). Used as the --template CLI argument.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for display and documentation.

source_pdf.description: Filename of the blank fillable PDF. Resolved relative to the templates directory or the scripts/ directory.

source_url.description: URL where the canonical blank template can be downloaded.

pdf_field.description: Exact AcroForm field name in the PDF.

type.description: Field type. 'text' = free text, 'initials' = short initial string, 'checkbox' = /Btn, 'signature' = normally blank for wet ink.

page.description: 0-indexed page number where this field appears.

max_chars.description: Maximum character count before truncation warning.

font_size_min.description: Minimum font size floor for auto-sizing.

group.description: Group name this field belongs to (e.g. 'general_authority').

groups.description: Named groups of related fields (e.g. grant-of-authority blocks).

all_field.description: Friendly key of the 'grant all' field for this group.

member_prefix.description: Prefix of friendly keys that are members of this group.

control_keys.description: Data keys that control fill behavior but are not direct field mappings.
